Name: Fireredlily's Bathroom Renovation
Author: fireredlily
Description:
[size=3]All those farmhouse upgrades and not a bathroom in sight. Well, no more! This mod adds a small bathroom that is located to the left of the hallway in the farmhouse's second upgrade (the upgrade that adds the hallway and kids room). Each bathroom includes a small pool-like tub area that can restore energy and a wall mirror enchanted by the Wizard to allow the player to change their appearance-- for a price.

Not enough room? No problem! Visit Robin and have her complete a new custom renovation to expand the bathroom to a larger size.[/size]

[size=4][b]Can you decorate the bathroom?
[/b][/size][size=3]Yes! The bathroom uses wallpaper and flooring that can be replaced, and furniture can be placed almost anywhere in the bathroom itself. There are even some repurposed floors and wallpapers from the game's interior maps that can be accessed via the catalog.[/size]

[b][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/b]
[size=3]- This mod was designed with the base game's farmhouse in mind.
- This mod may not be compatible with custom farmhouse mods that change the location of rooms.
- I am okay with farmhouse mod authors making their own patches to change the location of the bathroom and its renovation as needed, but mod authors must require that this mod be installed as a dependency if making a patch to it.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Adds a bathroom to the second house upgrade that can be expanded through Robin's farmhouse renovations. Restore energy in the indoor tub and change your appearance in the mirror, for a price, without needing to befriend the Wizard first!
